obligations.text: Harness contracts, state machine, receipts, manifests, negative oracles, and authorization firewalls are internally consistent and fail closed.
The canonical production path contains no spatial k-mode, SVT/gauge perturbation, transfer, stochastic primordial, likelihood, posterior, or real-data authority path.
Structure constants, Jacobi identities, class A/B registry, h-domain boundaries/aliases, and exceptional branches obey the canonical conventions.
Hamiltonian/momentum constraints and their propagation are evaluated from the same state and equations used by runtime evolution.
Each individually claimed Bianchi family has genuine background evolution and residual evidence, with h-boundaries and aliases tested but not double-counted.

Parameterized-family claims require an explicit h convention, disjoint exact domains, exact rational special-value dispatch, symbolic domain-wide identities, and runtime evidence that cannot be replaced by one representative h value.
Matter/radiation stress-energy coupling closes a declared energy-momentum ledger without double counting.
If global tilt is enabled, its forward dynamics, momentum constraints, admissible state domain, electron-frame coupling, and zero-tilt limit pass independently of the output-only local boost.

If global tilt is enabled, tilted momentum density and anisotropic stress enter the same Hamiltonian, momentum/Codazzi, and propagation constraints used by runtime evolution, with per-family admissibility and constraint propagation evidence.
Homogeneous Liouville transport, anisotropic redshift, direction flow, and screen-basis transport map exactly to executable operators.
Normal-frame transport, electron-frame collision/visibility, global tilt, and output-only local boost remain explicitly separated.
For each enabled polarization sector: density-matrix Hermiticity/PSD, spin-basis rotation, E/B parity, reality, and synthesis-analysis closure pass.

For each enabled collision/history sector: exact electron-frame kernel where selected, nullspace/equilibrium, photon number and energy exchange, history transitions, and no OTS/source double counting pass.
Photon number/energy, nuclei or matter charges as applicable, stress-energy, and Einstein constraints have explicit ledgers and tolerances.

For every enabled photon or exactly massless collisionless-neutrino species/spin block, ell_max, closure, angular/energy quadrature, timestep, and solver tolerances are jointly refined under declared norms for low-ell observables, the retained high-ell bulk, and a closure guard band.
No closure-front pile-up, aliasing, spurious reflection, species/spin-localized tail error, or E/B leakage is hidden by aggregate norms.
Stiffness handling, adaptive stepping, interpolation, positivity/realizability, and failure semantics are validated over the declared domain.
FLRW, Bianchi I, LRS, no-shear, no-tilt, collisionless, h-boundary/alias, and other applicable analytic/symmetry limits recover the convention-matched result.
Any Python/Rust/CAS/backend swap agrees for the same equations, inputs, precision, tolerance, and output semantics.
Release claims are promoted per feature and per family from durable gate evidence; no aggregate claim or readiness percentage substitutes for its constituent rows.
